root_causes.title: Missing Infigraph Runtime Wrapper
root_causes.description: The knowledgebase currently has no integration to invoke the Infigraph CLI or check its capabilities.
root_causes.solution_summary: Create a new script `scripts/analysis/infigraph.py` providing an `InfigraphRuntime` class that invokes the CLI, handles errors/timeouts, parses JSON output, and returns normalized statuses with reproducible metadata.

tasks.title: Add reproducible Infigraph runtime and capability contract
